content.comment_body: I'm planning a temperature monitoring project using [product_name] [article_no]. Which affordable sensor brands or models would you recommend for the four analog-capable inputs? The temperature range I need to measure is 70 to 200°F.

You have two main options: - Use a temperature transmitter with 0-10V output. - Use a temperature transmitter with 0 or 4-20mA output. For a current signal, you will need a 500 ohm resistor to convert the signal to 0-10V voltage output. Which kind of temperature sensor are you planning to use—PT100, PT1000, or something different?

I've completed multiple digital I/O projects with [product_name], but I am new to analog inputs and am unsure which analog devices are suitable or what pros and cons they have. This project will monitor boiler supply and return temperatures. My program will provide time and temperature statistics on a display.
Is this a personal or commercial project?

This is for personal use with my newly installed home hot water heating and domestic hot water system. I'm a hobbyist and enjoy working with home automation. My current setup uses low-cost digital temperature displays, but I want to upgrade to [product_name] for boiler monitoring from my PC or mobile device, so I'm looking for reasonably priced sensors.
You can find inexpensive converters for PT100 and PT1000 sensors from China on Ebay, and PT100 / PT1000 sensors themselves are also budget-friendly there. For example: [url]

Thanks for sharing this information! To confirm: I would connect a PT100 or PT1000 sensor to the converter, which then wires into the analog inputs (AI1, AI2, AI7, and AI8) of the [product_name] module?

The converter I mentioned works with 2-wire, 3-wire, and 4-wire PT100 / PT1000 sensors. It needs a 24VDC supply voltage and provides a 0-10V output, which you can connect straight to the analog inputs of the base module.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are discussing affordable temperature sensors and converter solutions compatible with the analog inputs of [product_name] for residential boiler monitoring. The original poster is new to analog devices and seeking recommendations suited for personal home automation, with cost efficiency and reliable integration being important factors.
analysis.user_expectations: The original poster expects clear advice on affordable and compatible temperature sensors and converters for use with [product_name] analog inputs. Guidance in choosing the best sensors and instructions on proper wiring for dependable monitoring are particularly valued.
